visualCharacteristics.layout: Third-party equitystory share price chart iframe (lazy-loaded) in a 1/3-width column, followed by a pill CTA button "Share Price Chart" linking to the full chart page

contentPattern: One row, one cell: optional link to the equitystory chart (https://charts3.equitystory.com/teaser-t1/continental-ag-v31/English/) - defaults to the Continental chart when omitted; avoid /widgets/ links here (scripts.js auto-blocks them; the block tolerates it and falls back to the default chart); followed by CTA link(s), e.g. "Share Price Chart" to /en/investors/shares/share-price-chart/
